name: Carmen Alvarez
bio: Carmen was elected mayor in 2022 and re-elected in 2025. She served two terms on the Council for District 3 and worked for 18 years as a public school teacher.

name: Darnell Hayes
bio: Darnell is a small business owner on the north side and chairs the Council's transportation committee.

name: Priscilla Nguyen
bio: Priscilla is a civil engineer and has led the Council's work on the Juniper Creek drainage program.

name: Robert Klein
bio: Robert is a retired firefighter who has lived in the Old Mill neighbourhood for 40 years.

name: Aisha Thompson
bio: Aisha is a nurse at Juniper Falls Regional and a founder of the Eastside Neighbors association.

name: Miguel Santos
bio: Miguel runs a family restaurant downtown and chairs the downtown redevelopment committee.

name: Hannah Brooks
bio: Hannah is an accountant and the Council's newest member, elected in May 2025.
